| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 30 | 1 to 200 | How many diffusion steps run. |
| **Time step** `dt` | 0.1 | 0.01 to 0.5 | The time step of each update. The coefficient is limited to 1, so steps up to 1 stay stable. |
| **Speckle scale q0** `q0` | 0.25 | 0.01 to 2 | The coefficient of variation of the speckle at the start. It plays the role of C_u in the Lee filter. |
| **Scale decay** `rho` | 0.17 | 0 to 1 | q0 falls with time as q0 exp(-rho t), with t the number of steps times the time step. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
